description: DataForSEO provides a RESTful API for accessing SERP data, page screenshots, and AI summaries using Basic Authentication.

evidence.claim: DataForSEO uses Basic Authentication via the Authorization header.
Create a free account to obtain API login and password for authentication.
DataForSEO offers SERP API endpoints including Google SERP, page screenshot, and AI summary.
APIs can be called from any programming language using Basic Auth, indicating integration is possible.
